'''Vagar Praxut'''<ref name="TUR" /> was a remote<ref name="CSWE Vagaari">{{CSWECite|III|290|Vagaari}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TUR" /> located within the [[Vagar Praxut system/Legends|Vagar Praxut system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It lay in the [[Kharmort's Miasma/Legends|Kharmort's Miasma]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]],<ref name="TUR" /> a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TEA" /> Vagar Praxut was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TUR" />

Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[30,000 BBY]], the inhabitants of Vagar Praxut became [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the sentient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], who altered the ecosystem of the planet. As the Vagaari adopted a nomadic lifestyle in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] no later than [[40 BBY/Legends|four decades]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Vagar Praxut eventually became almost entirely deserted.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The homeworld of the Vagaari was first mentioned in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE Vagaari" /> It was subsequently named by the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Vagar Praxut [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square H-9.<ref name="TEA" />
